name: Kaneko Minori
source: Kaneko Minori works in the health club in order to support herself and her family. A few years ago, her husband lost a lot of money in business and the family was in debt. As the pay was good, she eventually decided to work in health club and lied to her husband that she works as an overnight store clerk.
